C1135.title: zkLend $5M Hack Forced Return via Railgun
C1135.summary: In February 2025, lending protocol zkLend on Starknet was hacked, losing nearly $5 million. The attacker attempted to launder the funds through the privacy protocol Railgun, but its built-in anti-money laundering policy detected the anomaly and forcibly returned the illicit funds.
